instructions: This is dim0 (ARM-native fork): infinite canvas + board-aware agent. Backend FastAPI at DIM0_API_URL (default http://localhost:8081), frontend on :5175 (PROFILE=local).

ARM notes: webui/Dockerfile builds native arm64 (amd64 pin removed). Build with `make build PROFILE=local`, run with `make up PROFILE=local`. Backend needs OPENAI_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY to start (embedder).

Use the dim0 MCP tools (dim0_status first) for boards. Board writes need DIM0_API_TOKEN (JWT from POST /users/signin). Keep responses bounded: dim0_get_board defaults to summary; use whole=true sparingly.
